svg.title: coverage.txt from make -C hw sim-assert, only the bins with count 0
svg.desc: The 28 coverage bins that none of the 21 runs of the stream testbench reached, out of 89. They include payload sizes above 500 words and the maximum 65535, runs of a single frame, real-time runs with RATE below 20 or with a single destination, more than one dropped slot before a frame, five of the nine fault by payload-mode combinations, an abort before the first beat or while the sink is stalling, and an abort received while the source waits for a real-time slot or fills the FIR pipeline.

g.text: Payload stops at 500 words (legal up to 65535). Runs have 3 to 50 frames, never 1 and never more than 64.
No real-time frame has an odd length; no per-frame-TLAST run uses the FIR payload.
RATE is 20 at the lowest (legal: 2), never one destination; never 2 or more slots dropped between two frames.
5 of the 9 fault and payload-mode pairs never occur: for example a CRC fault is only injected in counter mode.
No abort before the first beat of a run, none while the sink stalls the source, none in a per-frame run mid-packet.
No abort arrives while the source pre-fills the FIR or waits for a slot; the one FORCE_ABORT came with TVALID high.
